title: Upswing reversal
description: An uptrend of higher highs and higher lows peaks at 71,289 (31 Mar 23:00). On 1 Apr 03:00 price closes at 70,597, below the previous higher low: a bearish market structure break. At level 1 the same close is the first bearish break of structure after the peak, and the downleg breaks lower twice more, to 66.5k.
